part1.tip: When a photo shows a static scene, check the verb tense first — present continuous ("is extending") describes an action in progress, so eliminate any choice describing a finished state.
part1.tipVn: Khi ảnh mô tả một hành động đang diễn ra, hãy kiểm tra thì động từ trước — hiện tại tiếp diễn ("is extending") mô tả hành động đang xảy ra, nên loại bỏ các đáp án mô tả trạng thái đã hoàn tất.
part1.tipTh: เมื่อภาพแสดงฉากที่หยุดนิ่ง ให้ตรวจสอบกาลของกริยาก่อน — present continuous ("is extending") อธิบายการกระทำที่กำลังดำเนินอยู่ ดังนั้นให้ตัดตัวเลือกที่อธิบายสถานะที่เสร็จสิ้นแล้วออก
part1.tipZh: 當照片顯示靜態或進行中的畫面時，先檢查動詞時態——現在進行式（"is extending"）描述正在進行的動作，因此可以排除描述已完成狀態的選項。
part1.tipFr: Lorsqu'une photo montre une scène en action, vérifiez d'abord le temps du verbe — le présent continu ("is extending") décrit une action en cours, donc éliminez tout choix décrivant un état déjà terminé.
part1.tipKo: 사진이 진행 중인 동작을 보여줄 때는 먼저 동사 시제를 확인하세요 — 현재진행형("is extending")은 진행 중인 동작을 나타내므로, 이미 끝난 상태를 묘사하는 선택지는 제외하세요.
part1.tipJa: 写真が進行中の動作を示している場合は、まず動詞の時制を確認しましょう — 現在進行形（"is extending"）は進行中の動作を表すため、完了した状態を表す選択肢は除外できます。
part1.tipId: Ketika foto menunjukkan tindakan yang sedang berlangsung, periksa dulu bentuk waktu kata kerja — present continuous ("is extending") menggambarkan tindakan yang sedang terjadi, jadi hilangkan pilihan yang menggambarkan keadaan yang sudah selesai.
part1.tipEl: Όταν μια φωτογραφία δείχνει μια ενέργεια σε εξέλιξη, ελέγξτε πρώτα τον χρόνο του ρήματος — ο ενεστώτας διαρκείας ("is extending") περιγράφει μια ενέργεια που συμβαίνει τώρα, οπότε απορρίψτε όποια επιλογή περιγράφει μια ολοκληρωμένη κατάσταση.
part1.tipEs: Cuando una foto muestra una acción en curso, primero revisa el tiempo verbal — el presente continuo ("is extending") describe una acción en progreso, así que elimina cualquier opción que describa un estado ya terminado.

part1.tip: Distractors often name a real object in the photo (plates, cupcakes) but pair it with the wrong verb (filling vs. taking out) — listen for the verb, not just the noun.
part1.tipVn: Đáp án nhiễu thường nêu đúng vật thể trong ảnh (đĩa, bánh cupcake) nhưng ghép với sai động từ (filling thay vì taking out) — hãy chú ý vào động từ, không chỉ danh từ.
part1.tipTh: ตัวลวงมักเอ่ยถึงวัตถุจริงในภาพ (จาน คัพเค้ก) แต่จับคู่กับกริยาผิด (filling แทนที่จะเป็น taking out) — ให้ฟังกริยา ไม่ใช่แค่คำนาม
part1.tipZh: 干擾選項常常提到照片中真實存在的物品（盤子、杯子蛋糕），卻搭配錯誤的動詞（filling 而非 taking out）——要專注聽動詞，而不只是名詞。
part1.tipFr: Les distracteurs mentionnent souvent un objet réel de la photo (assiettes, cupcakes) mais l'associent au mauvais verbe (filling au lieu de taking out) — écoutez le verbe, pas seulement le nom.
part1.tipKo: 오답 함정은 사진 속 실제 물건(접시, 컵케이크)을 언급하지만 잘못된 동사(filling 대신 taking out)와 짝지어 놓는 경우가 많습니다 — 명사뿐 아니라 동사를 잘 들으세요.
part1.tipJa: 誤答の選択肢は写真に実在する物（皿、カップケーキ）を挙げつつ、間違った動詞（filling ではなく taking out）と組み合わせることが多いです — 名詞だけでなく動詞に注意して聞きましょう。
part1.tipId: Pengecoh sering menyebutkan benda nyata dalam foto (piring, cupcake) tetapi memasangkannya dengan kata kerja yang salah (filling vs. taking out) — dengarkan kata kerjanya, bukan hanya kata bendanya.
part1.tipEl: Οι παγίδες συχνά αναφέρουν ένα πραγματικό αντικείμενο της φωτογραφίας (πιάτα, cupcakes) αλλά το συνδυάζουν με λάθος ρήμα (filling αντί για taking out) — ακούστε το ρήμα, όχι μόνο το ουσιαστικό.
part1.tipEs: Los distractores suelen nombrar un objeto real de la foto (platos, cupcakes) pero lo combinan con el verbo equivocado (filling en vez de taking out) — presta atención al verbo, no solo al sustantivo.

part1.tipVn: Cấu trúc bị động ("have been unfolded", "is being placed") mô tả kết quả hoặc hành động đang diễn ra lên một vật — hãy kiểm tra xem chủ ngữ là người thực hiện hay đối tượng chịu tác động.
part1.tipTh: โครงสร้าง passive ("have been unfolded", "is being placed") อธิบายผลลัพธ์หรือการกระทำที่กำลังเกิดขึ้นกับวัตถุ — ตรวจสอบว่าประธานเป็นผู้กระทำหรือผู้ถูกกระทำ
part1.tipZh: 被動結構（"have been unfolded"、"is being placed"）描述某物已完成的結果或正在進行的動作——請確認主詞是動作的執行者還是承受者。
part1.tipFr: Les constructions passives ("have been unfolded", "is being placed") décrivent le résultat ou une action en cours sur un objet — vérifiez si le sujet effectue l'action ou la subit.
part1.tipKo: 수동태 구조("have been unfolded", "is being placed")는 결과나 대상에게 진행 중인 동작을 나타냅니다 — 주어가 동작을 하는 쪽인지 받는 쪽인지 확인하세요.
part1.tipJa: 受動態の構文（"have been unfolded"、"is being placed"）は結果、または対象物に対する進行中の動作を表します — 主語が動作を行う側か受ける側かを確認しましょう。
part1.tipId: Konstruksi pasif ("have been unfolded", "is being placed") menggambarkan hasil atau tindakan yang sedang berlangsung pada suatu objek — periksa apakah subjek melakukan tindakan itu atau menerimanya.
part1.tipEl: Οι παθητικές κατασκευές ("have been unfolded", "is being placed") περιγράφουν το αποτέλεσμα ή μια ενέργεια σε εξέλιξη πάνω σε ένα αντικείμενο — ελέγξτε αν το υποκείμενο εκτελεί την ενέργεια ή τη δέχεται.
part1.tipEs: Las construcciones pasivas ("have been unfolded", "is being placed") describen el resultado o una acción en curso sobre un objeto — verifica si el sujeto realiza la acción o la recibe.

part1.tip: "Has been situated" (a fixed result) and "is being constructed" (an ongoing process) sound similar but describe different states — match the verb form to whether the scene shows a finished object or work-in-progress.
part1.tipVn: "Has been situated" (kết quả cố định) và "is being constructed" (quá trình đang diễn ra) nghe tương tự nhưng mô tả trạng thái khác nhau — hãy khớp dạng động từ với việc ảnh cho thấy vật đã hoàn thành hay đang được xây dựng.
part1.tipTh: "Has been situated" (ผลลัพธ์ที่คงที่) กับ "is being constructed" (กระบวนการที่กำลังดำเนินอยู่) ฟังดูคล้ายกันแต่บ่งบอกสถานะต่างกัน — จับคู่รูปกริยาให้ตรงกับว่าภาพแสดงวัตถุที่เสร็จแล้วหรือกำลังก่อสร้าง
part1.tipZh: "Has been situated"（固定結果）與 "is being constructed"（正在進行的過程）聽起來相似，卻描述不同的狀態——請依照畫面顯示的是已完成的物體還是施工中的過程來選擇對應的動詞形式。
part1.tipFr: "Has been situated" (un résultat fixe) et "is being constructed" (un processus en cours) se ressemblent mais décrivent des états différents — faites correspondre la forme verbale selon que la scène montre un objet terminé ou en construction.
part1.tipKo: "Has been situated"(고정된 결과)와 "is being constructed"(진행 중인 과정)는 비슷하게 들리지만 다른 상태를 나타냅니다 — 장면이 완성된 물체를 보여주는지 공사 중인 모습을 보여주는지에 맞춰 동사 형태를 선택하세요.
part1.tipJa: "Has been situated"（固定された結果）と "is being constructed"（進行中の過程）は似て聞こえますが異なる状態を表します — 場面が完成した物を示しているか、工事中の様子を示しているかで動詞の形を合わせましょう。
part1.tipId: "Has been situated" (hasil tetap) dan "is being constructed" (proses berlangsung) terdengar mirip tetapi menggambarkan keadaan berbeda — cocokkan bentuk kata kerja dengan apakah adegan menunjukkan objek yang sudah jadi atau sedang dibangun.
part1.tipEl: Το "has been situated" (ένα σταθερό αποτέλεσμα) και το "is being constructed" (μια διαδικασία σε εξέλιξη) ακούγονται παρόμοια αλλά περιγράφουν διαφορετικές καταστάσεις — ταιριάξτε τη μορφή του ρήματος ανάλογα με το αν η σκηνή δείχνει ένα ολοκληρωμένο αντικείμενο ή κάτι υπό κατασκευή.
part1.tipEs: "Has been situated" (un resultado fijo) y "is being constructed" (un proceso en curso) suenan parecido pero describen estados distintos — haz coincidir la forma verbal según si la escena muestra un objeto terminado o en construcción.

part5.tip: Reflexive pronouns (herself, himself, themselves) are used when the subject and object of the verb are the same person — "Emily introduced herself" means Emily is both the introducer and the one introduced.
part5.tipVn: Đại từ phản thân (herself, himself, themselves) được dùng khi chủ ngữ và tân ngữ của động từ là cùng một người — "Emily introduced herself" nghĩa là Emily vừa là người giới thiệu vừa là người được giới thiệu.
part5.tipTh: สรรพนามสะท้อน (herself, himself, themselves) ใช้เมื่อประธานและกรรมของกริยาเป็นคนเดียวกัน — "Emily introduced herself" หมายความว่า Emily เป็นทั้งผู้แนะนำและผู้ถูกแนะนำ
part5.tipZh: 反身代名詞（herself、himself、themselves）用於動詞的主詞和受詞是同一人時——"Emily introduced herself" 意思是 Emily 既是介紹者也是被介紹的人。
part5.tipFr: Les pronoms réfléchis (herself, himself, themselves) s'utilisent quand le sujet et l'objet du verbe désignent la même personne — "Emily introduced herself" signifie qu'Emily est à la fois celle qui présente et celle qui est présentée.
part5.tipKo: 재귀대명사(herself, himself, themselves)는 동사의 주어와 목적어가 같은 사람일 때 사용됩니다 — "Emily introduced herself"는 Emily가 소개하는 사람이자 소개받는 사람임을 뜻합니다.
part5.tipJa: 再帰代名詞（herself、himself、themselves）は動詞の主語と目的語が同一人物のときに使います — "Emily introduced herself" は、Emily が紹介する人であり紹介される人でもあることを意味します。
part5.tipId: Pronomina refleksif (herself, himself, themselves) digunakan saat subjek dan objek kata kerja adalah orang yang sama — "Emily introduced herself" berarti Emily adalah orang yang memperkenalkan sekaligus yang diperkenalkan.

part5.tipEs: En una oración imperativa que da instrucciones, mantén la estructura paralela: "Respond... and ask..." usa dos verbos en forma base unidos por "and" — lo que complete el espacio debe tener esa misma forma verbal.

*prior (tính từ): trước đó, tồn tại hoặc xảy ra trước một điều gì khác, hoặc trước một thời điểm cụ thể (prior engagements = những cuộc hẹn đã có từ trước)

questions.question: 105. Staff members with ------ engagements need not feel obliged to attend next week's field trip.

part5.hintTh:
*prior (คำคุณศัพท์): ก่อนหน้า มีอยู่หรือเกิดขึ้นก่อนสิ่งอื่น หรือก่อนช่วงเวลาที่ระบุ (prior engagements = นัดหมายที่มีอยู่ก่อนแล้ว)
*timely (คำคุณศัพท์): ทันเวลา เกิดขึ้นในเวลาที่ดีที่สุดเท่าที่จะเป็นไปได้
*late (คำคุณศัพท์): สาย (เกิดขึ้นหรืออยู่) ใกล้ช่วงท้ายของระยะเวลา
*old (คำคุณศัพท์): เก่า มีชีวิตอยู่หรือดำรงอยู่มาหลายปี
-> เลือก prior
part5.hintZh:
*prior（形容词）：先前的，存在或发生在其他事情之前，或某个特定时间之前（prior engagements = 事先已有的约定）
*timely（形容词）：及时的，在可能的最佳时机发生
*late（形容词）：晚的，（发生或存在于）某段时间的接近末尾处
*old（形容词）：旧的，已经存活或存在多年

part5.hintFr:
*prior (adjectif) : antérieur, qui existe ou se produit avant autre chose, ou avant un moment précis (prior engagements = engagements pris précédemment)
*timely (adjectif) : opportun, qui se produit au meilleur moment possible
*late (adjectif) : tardif, (se produisant ou existant) vers la fin d'une période
*old (adjectif) : vieux, qui a vécu ou existé pendant de nombreuses années
-> Choisir prior
part5.hintKo:
*prior (형용사): 이전의, 다른 것보다 먼저 존재하거나 발생하는, 또는 특정 시점 이전의 (prior engagements = 기존에 있던 약속)
*timely (형용사): 시기적절한, 가능한 가장 좋은 시기에 발생하는
*late (형용사): 늦은, 기간의 끝 무렵에 (발생하거나 존재하는)

-> prior 선택
part5.hintJa:

*timely（形容詞）：時宜を得た、可能な限り最良の時期に起こる
*late（形容詞）：遅い、（ある期間の）終わりに近い（発生または存在する）

part5.hintId:

part5.hintEl:
*prior (επίθετο): προηγούμενος, υπάρχει ή συμβαίνει πριν από κάτι άλλο, ή πριν από μια συγκεκριμένη στιγμή (prior engagements = προγενέστερες δεσμεύσεις)

part5.hintEs:

*old (adjetivo): viejo, que ha vivido o existido durante muchos años

part5.tip: Adjectives with similar spelling (prior, timely, late, old) have very different meanings — "prior" means "before", so check whether the sentence needs a time-order word or a quality word.
part5.tipVn: Các tính từ có hình thức gần giống nhau (prior, timely, late, old) mang nghĩa rất khác nhau — "prior" nghĩa là "trước đó", nên hãy kiểm tra câu cần một từ chỉ thứ tự thời gian hay một từ chỉ tính chất.
part5.tipTh: คำคุณศัพท์ที่สะกดคล้ายกัน (prior, timely, late, old) มีความหมายต่างกันมาก — "prior" หมายถึง "ก่อนหน้า" ดังนั้นให้ตรวจสอบว่าประโยคต้องการคำบอกลำดับเวลาหรือคำบอกคุณสมบัติ
part5.tipZh: 拼字相近的形容詞（prior、timely、late、old）意思差異很大——"prior" 意思是「先前的」，因此要檢查句子需要的是表示時間順序的詞還是表示性質的詞。
part5.tipFr: Des adjectifs à l'orthographe proche (prior, timely, late, old) ont des sens très différents — "prior" signifie "antérieur", vérifiez donc si la phrase a besoin d'un mot d'ordre temporel ou d'un mot de qualité.
part5.tipKo: 철자가 비슷한 형용사(prior, timely, late, old)는 의미가 매우 다릅니다 — "prior"는 "이전의"라는 뜻이므로, 문장이 시간 순서를 나타내는 단어를 필요로 하는지 성질을 나타내는 단어를 필요로 하는지 확인하세요.
part5.tipJa: 綴りが似た形容詞（prior、timely、late、old）は意味が大きく異なります — "prior" は「以前の」という意味なので、文が時間順を表す語を必要としているか、性質を表す語を必要としているか確認しましょう。
part5.tipId: Kata sifat dengan ejaan mirip (prior, timely, late, old) memiliki arti yang sangat berbeda — "prior" berarti "sebelumnya", jadi periksa apakah kalimat membutuhkan kata urutan waktu atau kata kualitas.
part5.tipEl: Επίθετα με παρόμοια ορθογραφία (prior, timely, late, old) έχουν πολύ διαφορετικές σημασίες — το "prior" σημαίνει "πριν", οπότε ελέγξτε αν η πρόταση χρειάζεται λέξη χρονικής σειράς ή λέξη ποιότητας.
part5.tipEs: Los adjetivos con ortografía parecida (prior, timely, late, old) tienen significados muy distintos — "prior" significa "anterior", así que revisa si la oración necesita una palabra de orden temporal o una de cualidad.

part5.tip: A time phrase like "in the next couple of days" signals a planned future action, which in TOEIC grammar is often expressed with present continuous (is/am/are + V-ing), not simple present.
part5.tipVn: Cụm chỉ thời gian như "in the next couple of days" báo hiệu một hành động tương lai đã lên kế hoạch, trong ngữ pháp TOEIC thường diễn đạt bằng hiện tại tiếp diễn (is/am/are + V-ing), không phải hiện tại đơn.
part5.tipTh: วลีบอกเวลาอย่าง "in the next couple of days" บ่งบอกถึงการกระทำในอนาคตที่วางแผนไว้ ซึ่งในไวยากรณ์ TOEIC มักใช้ present continuous (is/am/are + V-ing) ไม่ใช่ present simple
part5.tipZh: 像 "in the next couple of days" 這樣的時間片語暗示已計劃好的未來動作，在 TOEIC 文法中通常用現在進行式（is/am/are + V-ing）表達，而非現在簡單式。
part5.tipFr: Une expression de temps comme "in the next couple of days" annonce une action future planifiée, souvent exprimée en grammaire TOEIC par le présent continu (is/am/are + V-ing), pas le présent simple.
part5.tipKo: "in the next couple of days"와 같은 시간 표현은 계획된 미래 행동을 나타내며, TOEIC 문법에서는 흔히 현재진행형(is/am/are + V-ing)으로 표현하지 단순현재로 표현하지 않습니다.
part5.tipJa: "in the next couple of days" のような時間表現は計画された未来の行動を示し、TOEIC文法では単純現在ではなく現在進行形（is/am/are + V-ing）で表されることが多いです。
part5.tipId: Frasa waktu seperti "in the next couple of days" menandakan tindakan masa depan yang direncanakan, yang dalam tata bahasa TOEIC sering diungkapkan dengan present continuous (is/am/are + V-ing), bukan present simple.
part5.tipEl: Μια χρονική φράση όπως "in the next couple of days" υποδηλώνει μια προγραμματισμένη μελλοντική ενέργεια, η οποία στη γραμματική του TOEIC συχνά εκφράζεται με ενεστώτα διαρκείας (is/am/are + V-ing), όχι απλό ενεστώτα.
part5.tipEs: Una frase temporal como "in the next couple of days" indica una acción futura planificada, que en la gramática de TOEIC suele expresarse con presente continuo (is/am/are + V-ing), no presente simple.

part5.hint: S + was + {ADV} + decorated (main V)

questions.question: 107. The banquet hall was ------ decorated for the fund-raising gala on June 11.

part5.hintZh:

part5.hintFr:

part5.hintKo:

part5.hintJa:
- 文の主動詞は'decorated'（was decorated - 受動態）で、空欄はこの動詞を修飾する副詞（adverb）が必要：S + was + ADV + decorated

part5.hintId:

part5.hintEl:
- Το κύριο ρήμα της πρότασης είναι 'decorated' (was decorated - παθητική φωνή), το κενό χρειάζεται ένα επίρρημα (adverb) για να τροποποιήσει αυτό το ρήμα: S + was + ADV + decorated

part5.hintEs:

-> Elegir elaborately

part5.tip: Adverbs modify verbs and usually sit right before the main verb in a passive sentence: "was + ADV + decorated" — make sure the blank takes an adverb, not an adjective or noun.
part5.tipVn: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ và thường đứng ngay trước động từ chính trong câu bị động: "was + ADV + decorated" — hãy chắc chắn chỗ trống cần một trạng từ, không phải tính từ hay danh từ.
part5.tipTh: กริยาวิเศษณ์ขยายกริยาและมักอยู่หน้ากริยาหลักในประโยค passive: "was + ADV + decorated" — ตรวจสอบให้แน่ใจว่าช่องว่างต้องการกริยาวิเศษณ์ ไม่ใช่คำคุณศัพท์หรือคำนาม
part5.tipZh: 副詞修飾動詞，在被動句中通常緊接在主要動詞之前："was + ADV + decorated"——請確認空格需要的是副詞，而不是形容詞或名詞。
part5.tipFr: Les adverbes modifient les verbes et se placent généralement juste avant le verbe principal dans une phrase passive : "was + ADV + decorated" — assurez-vous que l'espace nécessite un adverbe, pas un adjectif ou un nom.
part5.tipKo: 부사는 동사를 수식하며 수동태 문장에서 보통 본동사 바로 앞에 옵니다: "was + ADV + decorated" — 빈칸이 형용사나 명사가 아니라 부사를 필요로 하는지 확인하세요.
part5.tipJa: 副詞は動詞を修飾し、受動態の文では通常、本動詞の直前に置かれます："was + ADV + decorated" — 空欄が形容詞や名詞ではなく副詞を必要としていることを確認しましょう。
part5.tipId: Kata keterangan memodifikasi kata kerja dan biasanya terletak tepat sebelum kata kerja utama dalam kalimat pasif: "was + ADV + decorated" — pastikan bagian kosong membutuhkan kata keterangan, bukan kata sifat atau kata benda.
part5.tipEl: Τα επιρρήματα τροποποιούν ρήματα και συνήθως τοποθετούνται ακριβώς πριν από το κύριο ρήμα σε μια παθητική πρόταση: "was + ADV + decorated" — βεβαιωθείτε ότι το κενό χρειάζεται επίρρημα, όχι επίθετο ή ουσιαστικό.
part5.tipEs: Los adverbios modifican verbos y suelen colocarse justo antes del verbo principal en una oración pasiva: "was + ADV + decorated" — asegúrate de que el espacio necesita un adverbio, no un adjetivo ni un sustantivo.

part5.tipTh: เมื่อช่องว่างอยู่ระหว่างคำนำหน้านามกับคำนาม ("an ___ role") ต้องการคำคุณศัพท์มาขยายคำนามนั้น — ตรวจสอบชนิดของคำรอบข้างก่อนเลือกคำที่แค่ "ฟังดูถูก"
part5.tipZh: 當空格位於冠詞和名詞之間（"an ___ role"）時，需要一個形容詞來修飾該名詞——在選擇「聽起來對」的詞之前，先檢查周圍詞語的詞性。
part5.tipFr: Lorsqu'un espace se trouve entre un article et un nom ("an ___ role"), il faut un adjectif pour modifier ce nom — vérifiez la nature grammaticale des mots environnants avant de choisir un mot qui "sonne bien".

part5.tipJa: 空欄が冠詞と名詞の間にある場合（"an ___ role"）、その名詞を修飾する形容詞が必要です — 単に「合いそうな」語を選ぶ前に、周りの語の品詞を確認しましょう。
part5.tipId: Ketika bagian kosong berada di antara artikel dan kata benda ("an ___ role"), dibutuhkan kata sifat untuk memodifikasi kata benda itu — periksa jenis kata di sekitarnya sebelum memilih kata yang sekadar "terdengar cocok".
part5.tipEl: Όταν ένα κενό βρίσκεται ανάμεσα σε ένα άρθρο και ένα ουσιαστικό ("an ___ role"), χρειάζεται ένα επίθετο για να τροποποιήσει αυτό το ουσιαστικό — ελέγξτε το μέρος του λόγου των γύρω λέξεων πριν επιλέξετε μια λέξη που απλώς "ακούγεται σωστή".
part5.tipEs: Cuando un espacio está entre un artículo y un sustantivo ("an ___ role"), necesita un adjetivo que modifique ese sustantivo — revisa la categoría gramatical de las palabras cercanas antes de elegir una que solo "suene bien".

part5.tip: Phrasal verbs (come up with, drop by, look in on, run out of) each carry a distinct fixed meaning — memorize them as whole units rather than translating word by word.

part5.tipTh: 'phrasal verb' แต่ละคำ (come up with, drop by, look in on, run out of) มีความหมายคงที่เฉพาะตัว — จำเป็นวลีทั้งชุดแทนการแปลทีละคำ
part5.tipZh: 片語動詞（come up with、drop by、look in on、run out of）各自有固定的獨特含義——請把它們當作整體記憶，而不是逐字翻譯。
part5.tipFr: Les verbes à particule (come up with, drop by, look in on, run out of) portent chacun un sens fixe distinct — mémorisez-les comme des unités entières plutôt que de les traduire mot à mot.
part5.tipKo: 구동사(come up with, drop by, look in on, run out of)는 각각 고유한 고정된 의미를 가지고 있습니다 — 단어별로 번역하지 말고 통째로 외우세요.

part5.tipId: Kata kerja frasa (come up with, drop by, look in on, run out of) masing-masing memiliki makna tetap yang khas — hafalkan sebagai satu kesatuan, bukan menerjemahkan kata per kata.

part5.tipEs: Los phrasal verbs (come up with, drop by, look in on, run out of) tienen cada uno un significado fijo distinto — apréndelos como unidades completas en vez de traducirlos palabra por palabra.

part5.tip: Idioms like "under pressure" must be learned as a fixed phrase — swapping the preposition ("in pressure", "on pressure") is a common trap for non-native speakers.
part5.tipVn: Thành ngữ như "under pressure" cần được học như một cụm cố định — thay đổi giới từ ("in pressure", "on pressure") là lỗi phổ biến của người học không phải bản ngữ.
part5.tipTh: สำนวนอย่าง "under pressure" ต้องเรียนรู้เป็นวลีตายตัว — การเปลี่ยนบุพบท ("in pressure", "on pressure") เป็นกับดักที่พบบ่อยสำหรับผู้ที่ไม่ใช่เจ้าของภาษา
part5.tipZh: 像 "under pressure" 這樣的成語必須當作固定片語來學習——更換介詞（"in pressure"、"on pressure"）是非母語學習者常見的陷阱。
part5.tipFr: Les expressions idiomatiques comme "under pressure" doivent être apprises comme une phrase fixe — changer la préposition ("in pressure", "on pressure") est un piège courant pour les non-natifs.
part5.tipKo: "under pressure" 같은 관용구는 고정된 표현으로 익혀야 합니다 — 전치사를 바꾸는 것("in pressure", "on pressure")은 비원어민이 흔히 빠지는 함정입니다.
part5.tipJa: "under pressure" のようなイディオムは決まった句として覚える必要があります — 前置詞を入れ替えること（"in pressure"、"on pressure"）は非ネイティブによくある罠です。
part5.tipId: Idiom seperti "under pressure" harus dipelajari sebagai frasa tetap — mengganti preposisinya ("in pressure", "on pressure") adalah jebakan umum bagi penutur non-native.
part5.tipEl: Ιδιωματισμοί όπως το "under pressure" πρέπει να μαθαίνονται ως σταθερή φράση — η αλλαγή της πρόθεσης ("in pressure", "on pressure") είναι μια συνηθισμένη παγίδα για μη φυσικούς ομιλητές.
part5.tipEs: Los modismos como "under pressure" deben aprenderse como frase fija — cambiar la preposición ("in pressure", "on pressure") es una trampa común para hablantes no nativos.

part5.tip: Adverbs ending in -ly can look interchangeable but differ sharply in meaning (consistently = unchanging, conveniently = suitable, temporarily = short-lived) — always check what idea the sentence needs, not just the part of speech.
part5.tipVn: Các trạng từ tận cùng -ly có thể trông giống nhau nhưng khác nhau rõ rệt về nghĩa (consistently = không đổi, conveniently = thuận tiện, temporarily = tạm thời) — luôn kiểm tra ý nghĩa câu cần, không chỉ từ loại.
part5.tipTh: กริยาวิเศษณ์ลงท้ายด้วย -ly อาจดูใช้แทนกันได้แต่มีความหมายต่างกันชัดเจน (consistently = ไม่เปลี่ยนแปลง, conveniently = สะดวก, temporarily = ชั่วคราว) — ตรวจสอบเสมอว่าประโยคต้องการความหมายใด ไม่ใช่แค่ชนิดของคำ
part5.tipZh: 以 -ly 結尾的副詞看似可以互換，實則意思差異很大（consistently = 一貫不變，conveniently = 方便的，temporarily = 暫時的）——務必檢查句子所需的意思，而不僅是詞性。
part5.tipFr: Les adverbes en -ly peuvent sembler interchangeables mais diffèrent nettement en sens (consistently = invariable, conveniently = pratique, temporarily = temporaire) — vérifiez toujours l'idée dont la phrase a besoin, pas seulement la nature grammaticale.
part5.tipKo: -ly로 끝나는 부사들은 서로 바꿔 쓸 수 있어 보이지만 의미가 크게 다릅니다(consistently = 변함없이, conveniently = 편리하게, temporarily = 일시적으로) — 품사만이 아니라 문장이 필요로 하는 의미를 항상 확인하세요.
part5.tipJa: -ly で終わる副詞は互換性があるように見えても意味は大きく異なります（consistently = 一貫して、conveniently = 都合よく、temporarily = 一時的に）— 品詞だけでなく文が必要とする意味を常に確認しましょう。
part5.tipId: Kata keterangan berakhiran -ly bisa terlihat dapat dipertukarkan tetapi maknanya sangat berbeda (consistently = tidak berubah, conveniently = sesuai, temporarily = sementara) — selalu periksa gagasan yang dibutuhkan kalimat, bukan hanya jenis katanya.
part5.tipEl: Τα επιρρήματα που τελειώνουν σε -ly μπορεί να φαίνονται εναλλάξιμα αλλά διαφέρουν έντονα στη σημασία (consistently = σταθερά, conveniently = βολικά, temporarily = προσωρινά) — ελέγχετε πάντα ποια ιδέα χρειάζεται η πρόταση, όχι μόνο το μέρος του λόγου.
part5.tipEs: Los adverbios terminados en -ly pueden parecer intercambiables pero difieren mucho en significado (consistently = de forma constante, conveniently = de forma conveniente, temporarily = temporalmente) — siempre revisa qué idea necesita la oración, no solo la categoría gramatical.

part5.hintJa:

part5.tip: Subject-verb agreement depends on whether the subject is singular or plural: "those" takes a plural verb while "anyone" always takes a singular verb, even though both can refer to people.
part5.tipVn: Sự hòa hợp chủ ngữ - động từ phụ thuộc vào chủ ngữ số ít hay số nhiều: "those" đi với động từ số nhiều còn "anyone" luôn đi với động từ số ít, dù cả hai đều có thể chỉ người.
part5.tipTh: การสอดคล้องประธาน-กริยาขึ้นอยู่กับว่าประธานเป็นเอกพจน์หรือพหูพจน์: "those" ใช้กริยาพหูพจน์ ส่วน "anyone" ใช้กริยาเอกพจน์เสมอ แม้ทั้งสองจะหมายถึงคนได้
part5.tipZh: 主詞動詞一致取決於主詞是單數還是複數："those" 搭配複數動詞，而 "anyone" 一律搭配單數動詞，儘管兩者都可以指人。
part5.tipFr: L'accord sujet-verbe dépend du fait que le sujet est singulier ou pluriel : "those" prend un verbe pluriel tandis que "anyone" prend toujours un verbe singulier, même si les deux peuvent désigner des personnes.
part5.tipKo: 주어-동사 일치는 주어가 단수인지 복수인지에 따라 달라집니다: "those"는 복수 동사를 취하지만 "anyone"은 항상 단수 동사를 취합니다. 둘 다 사람을 가리킬 수 있어도 마찬가지입니다.
part5.tipJa: 主語と動詞の一致は主語が単数か複数かによります："those" は複数動詞を、"anyone" は常に単数動詞を取ります。どちらも人を指すことがあっても同様です。
part5.tipId: Kesesuaian subjek-kata kerja bergantung pada apakah subjek tunggal atau jamak: "those" menggunakan kata kerja jamak sedangkan "anyone" selalu menggunakan kata kerja tunggal, meskipun keduanya bisa merujuk pada orang.
part5.tipEl: Η συμφωνία υποκειμένου-ρήματος εξαρτάται από το αν το υποκείμενο είναι ενικός ή πληθυντικός: το "those" παίρνει ρήμα σε πληθυντικό ενώ το "anyone" παίρνει πάντα ρήμα σε ενικό, παρόλο που και τα δύο μπορούν να αναφέρονται σε ανθρώπους.
part5.tipEs: La concordancia sujeto-verbo depende de si el sujeto es singular o plural: "those" lleva verbo plural mientras que "anyone" siempre lleva verbo singular, aunque ambos puedan referirse a personas.

'reserve' (ρήμα): κρατώ, φυλάσσω (όπως μια θέση σε αεροπλάνο ή ένα τραπέζι σε εστιατόριο) για μελλοντική χρήση
'continue' (ρήμα): συνεχίζω, εξακολουθώ να συμβαίνω, να υπάρχω ή να κάνω κάτι

part5.tip: Verbs like suggest, attract, reserve, and continue take different structures after them — check whether the sentence needs a verb followed by a noun, an -ing form, or a that-clause.
part5.tipVn: Các động từ như suggest, attract, reserve, continue đòi hỏi cấu trúc khác nhau theo sau — hãy kiểm tra câu cần động từ theo sau là danh từ, dạng -ing, hay mệnh đề that.
part5.tipTh: กริยาอย่าง suggest, attract, reserve, continue ต้องการโครงสร้างต่างกันตามหลัง — ตรวจสอบว่าประโยคต้องการกริยาตามด้วยคำนาม รูป -ing หรืออนุประโยค that
part5.tipZh: 像 suggest、attract、reserve、continue 這樣的動詞後面接的結構各不相同——請檢查句子需要的是接名詞、-ing 形式，還是 that 子句的動詞。
part5.tipFr: Des verbes comme suggest, attract, reserve et continue exigent des structures différentes après eux — vérifiez si la phrase a besoin d'un verbe suivi d'un nom, d'une forme en -ing, ou d'une proposition en that.

part5.tipJa: suggest、attract、reserve、continue のような動詞は後ろに異なる構造を取ります — 文が名詞、-ing形、that節のどれを伴う動詞を必要としているか確認しましょう。
part5.tipId: Kata kerja seperti suggest, attract, reserve, dan continue memerlukan struktur berbeda setelahnya — periksa apakah kalimat membutuhkan kata kerja diikuti kata benda, bentuk -ing, atau klausa that.
part5.tipEl: Ρήματα όπως suggest, attract, reserve και continue απαιτούν διαφορετικές δομές μετά από αυτά — ελέγξτε αν η πρόταση χρειάζεται ρήμα ακολουθούμενο από ουσιαστικό, μορφή -ing, ή πρόταση με that.
part5.tipEs: Verbos como suggest, attract, reserve y continue requieren estructuras diferentes después de ellos — revisa si la oración necesita un verbo seguido de un sustantivo, una forma en -ing, o una cláusula con that.

part5.tipVn: "Regarding" (về việc) là giới từ trang trọng thường gặp ở đầu email công việc — hãy luyện nhận diện giới từ giới thiệu chủ đề khác với giới từ chỉ vị trí (behind, across).
part5.tipTh: "Regarding" (เกี่ยวกับ) เป็นบุพบทที่เป็นทางการที่พบบ่อยในตอนเปิดอีเมลธุรกิจ — ฝึกแยกแยะบุพบทที่แนะนำหัวข้อกับบุพบทที่บอกตำแหน่ง (behind, across)
part5.tipZh: "Regarding"（關於）是商業郵件開頭常見的正式介詞——練習分辨引出話題的介詞和表示位置的介詞（behind、across）的不同。
part5.tipFr: "Regarding" (à propos de) est une préposition formelle courante en début d'e-mail professionnel — entraînez-vous à reconnaître les prépositions qui introduisent un sujet par rapport à celles qui indiquent une position (behind, across).
part5.tipKo: "Regarding"(~에 관하여)는 업무 이메일 도입부에서 흔히 쓰이는 격식 있는 전치사입니다 — 주제를 소개하는 전치사와 위치를 나타내는 전치사(behind, across)를 구별하는 연습을 하세요.
part5.tipJa: "Regarding"（〜に関して）はビジネスメールの冒頭でよく使われる正式な前置詞です — 話題を導入する前置詞と位置を示す前置詞（behind、across）を見分ける練習をしましょう。
part5.tipId: "Regarding" (mengenai) adalah preposisi formal umum di awal email bisnis — latih mengenali preposisi yang memperkenalkan topik dibandingkan yang menunjukkan posisi (behind, across).
part5.tipEl: Το "regarding" (σχετικά με) είναι μια συνηθισμένη επίσημη πρόθεση στην αρχή επαγγελματικών email — εξασκηθείτε στο να αναγνωρίζετε προθέσεις που εισάγουν ένα θέμα σε αντίθεση με αυτές που δείχνουν θέση (behind, across).
part5.tipEs: "Regarding" (con respecto a) es una preposición formal común al inicio de correos de negocios — practica reconocer preposiciones que introducen un tema frente a las que indican posición (behind, across).

part5.hintZh:

'Attend'（动词）：出席，前往某活动、地点等
'Attendee'（名词）：参加者（某活动的）

- 主语在句首，需要一个表示总体概念的名词，与单数动词'increased'一致

part5.hintFr:
{'Attendance'} (nom) : le nombre de personnes présentes à un événement, une réunion, etc.
'Attend' (v) : assister, se rendre à un événement, un lieu, etc.

part5.hintKo:

part5.hintJa:
{'Attendance'}（名詞）：イベントや会議などへの参加者数
'Attend'（動詞）：出席する、イベントや場所などに行く
'Attendee'（名詞）：参加者（あるイベントの）

part5.hintId:
{'Attendance'} (kata benda): jumlah orang yang menghadiri sebuah acara, rapat, dll.
'Attend' (kata kerja): menghadiri, pergi ke sebuah acara, tempat, dll.
'Attendee' (kata benda): peserta (sebuah acara)
'Attendant' (kata benda): orang yang bertugas berada di suatu tempat untuk membantu pengunjung atau pelanggan
- Subjek di awal kalimat memerlukan kata benda konsep umum yang sesuai dengan kata kerja tunggal 'increased'
-> Pilih Attendance
part5.hintEl:
{'Attendance'} (ουσιαστικό): ο αριθμός των ατόμων που παρευρίσκονται σε μια εκδήλωση, συνάντηση κ.λπ.
'Attend' (ρήμα): παρευρίσκομαι, πηγαίνω σε μια εκδήλωση, τοποθεσία κ.λπ.
'Attendee' (ουσιαστικό): συμμετέχων (σε μια εκδήλωση)
'Attendant' (ουσιαστικό): άτομο του οποίου το καθήκον είναι να είναι παρόν σε ένα μέρος για να βοηθά επισκέπτες ή πελάτες

-> Επιλογή Attendance
part5.hintEs:
{'Attendance'} (sustantivo): el número de personas que asisten a un evento, reunión, etc.
'Attend' (verbo): asistir, ir a un evento, lugar, etc.
'Attendee' (sustantivo): asistente (de un evento)
'Attendant' (sustantivo): persona cuyo deber es estar presente en un lugar para ayudar a visitantes o clientes

-> Elegir Attendance
part5.tip: Related noun forms sharing a root (attendance, attend, attendee, attendant) each have a distinct grammatical role — "attendance" is uncountable and refers to the overall turnout, not an individual person.
part5.tipVn: Các danh từ cùng gốc (attendance, attend, attendee, attendant) có vai trò ngữ pháp khác nhau — "attendance" là danh từ không đếm được, chỉ tổng số người tham dự, không phải một cá nhân.
part5.tipTh: คำนามที่มีรากศัพท์เดียวกัน (attendance, attend, attendee, attendant) มีบทบาททางไวยากรณ์ต่างกัน — "attendance" เป็นคำนามนับไม่ได้ หมายถึงจำนวนผู้เข้าร่วมโดยรวม ไม่ใช่บุคคลใดบุคคลหนึ่ง
part5.tipZh: 同根名詞（attendance、attend、attendee、attendant）各自有不同的語法角色——"attendance" 是不可數名詞，指整體出席人數，而非個別的人。
part5.tipFr: Les formes nominales apparentées (attendance, attend, attendee, attendant) ont chacune un rôle grammatical distinct — "attendance" est indénombrable et désigne l'affluence globale, pas une personne individuelle.
part5.tipKo: 같은 어근을 공유하는 명사(attendance, attend, attendee, attendant)는 각각 고유한 문법적 역할을 가집니다 — "attendance"는 불가산명사로 개별 사람이 아니라 전체 참석자 수를 가리킵니다.
part5.tipJa: 同じ語根を持つ名詞（attendance、attend、attendee、attendant）はそれぞれ異なる文法的役割を持ちます — "attendance" は不可算名詞で、個人ではなく全体の出席者数を指します。
part5.tipId: Bentuk kata benda serumpun (attendance, attend, attendee, attendant) masing-masing memiliki peran gramatikal yang berbeda — "attendance" tidak dapat dihitung dan merujuk pada jumlah kehadiran keseluruhan, bukan satu orang.
part5.tipEl: Σχετικές ονοματικές μορφές με κοινή ρίζα (attendance, attend, attendee, attendant) έχουν η καθεμία διαφορετικό γραμματικό ρόλο — το "attendance" είναι μη μετρήσιμο και αναφέρεται στη συνολική προσέλευση, όχι σε ένα άτομο.
part5.tipEs: Las formas nominales relacionadas por una raíz común (attendance, attend, attendee, attendant) tienen cada una un rol gramatical distinto — "attendance" es incontable y se refiere a la asistencia total, no a una persona individual.

part5.hint:
{'notwithstanding'}/'in spite of'/'despite' + N / V_ing
'even though'/'although' + a clause
'thereby': as a result of this action
'aside from': except for
part5.hintVn:
{'notwithstanding'}/'in spite of'/'despite' + N/V-ing (mặc dù + danh từ/V-ing)
'even though'/'although' + mệnh đề (mặc dù + mệnh đề có đủ chủ ngữ - động từ)
'thereby': nhờ đó, như một kết quả của hành động này
'aside from': ngoại trừ
- Chỗ trống đứng trước cụm danh từ 'the large size of the facility' (không phải một mệnh đề) -> cần giới từ mang nghĩa 'mặc dù'.
-> chọn notwithstanding.

questions.question: 120. During the summer, rooms at the Marigold Hotel are always fully booked ------ the large size of the facility.

part5.hintTh:
{'notwithstanding'}/'in spite of'/'despite' + คำนาม/V-ing (แม้ว่า + คำนาม/V-ing)
'even though'/'although' + อนุประโยค (แม้ว่า + อนุประโยคที่มีประธาน-กริยาครบ)
'thereby': ด้วยเหตุนั้น เป็นผลจากการกระทำนี้
'aside from': นอกเหนือจาก
- ช่องว่างอยู่หน้ากลุ่มคำนาม 'the large size of the facility' (ไม่ใช่อนุประโยค) -> ต้องการคำบุพบทที่แปลว่า 'แม้ว่า'
-> เลือก notwithstanding
part5.hintZh:
{'notwithstanding'}/'in spite of'/'despite' + 名词/V-ing（尽管 + 名词/V-ing）
'even though'/'although' + 从句（尽管 + 有完整主谓的从句）
'thereby'：因此，作为该行动的结果
'aside from'：除……之外
- 空格位于名词短语'the large size of the facility'（并非从句）之前 -> 需要表示'尽管'意思的介词
-> 选 notwithstanding
part5.hintFr:
{'notwithstanding'}/'in spite of'/'despite' + N/V-ing (malgré + nom/V-ing)
'even though'/'although' + proposition (bien que + proposition avec sujet-verbe complet)
'thereby' : de ce fait, en conséquence de cette action
'aside from' : en dehors de
- Le blanc précède le groupe nominal 'the large size of the facility' (pas une proposition) -> il faut une préposition signifiant « malgré »
-> Choisir notwithstanding
part5.hintKo:
{'notwithstanding'}/'in spite of'/'despite' + 명사/V-ing (~에도 불구하고 + 명사/V-ing)
'even though'/'although' + 절 (~에도 불구하고 + 주어-동사가 완전한 절)
'thereby': 그것으로 인해, 이 행동의 결과로서
'aside from': ~을 제외하고
- 빈칸은 명사구 'the large size of the facility'(절이 아님) 앞에 있음 -> '~에도 불구하고'라는 뜻의 전치사가 필요
-> notwithstanding 선택
part5.hintJa:
{'notwithstanding'}/'in spite of'/'despite' + 名詞/V-ing（〜にもかかわらず + 名詞/V-ing）
'even though'/'although' + 節（〜にもかかわらず + 主語動詞が完全な節）
'thereby'：それによって、この行動の結果として
'aside from'：〜を除いて
- 空欄は名詞句'the large size of the facility'（節ではない）の前にある -> 「〜にもかかわらず」を意味する前置詞が必要
-> notwithstandingを選択
part5.hintId:
{'notwithstanding'}/'in spite of'/'despite' + N/V-ing (meskipun + kata benda/V-ing)
'even though'/'although' + klausa (meskipun + klausa dengan subjek-kata kerja lengkap)
'thereby': dengan demikian, sebagai hasil dari tindakan ini
'aside from': selain dari
- Bagian kosong berada sebelum frasa kata benda 'the large size of the facility' (bukan klausa) -> memerlukan preposisi yang berarti 'meskipun'
-> Pilih notwithstanding
part5.hintEl:
{'notwithstanding'}/'in spite of'/'despite' + Ουσιαστικό/V-ing (παρά + ουσιαστικό/V-ing)
'even though'/'although' + πρόταση (παρόλο που + πρόταση με πλήρες υποκείμενο-ρήμα)
'thereby': με αυτόν τον τρόπο, ως αποτέλεσμα αυτής της ενέργειας
'aside from': εκτός από
- Το κενό βρίσκεται πριν από την ονοματική φράση 'the large size of the facility' (όχι πρόταση) -> χρειάζεται πρόθεση που σημαίνει «παρά»
-> Επιλογή notwithstanding
part5.hintEs:
{'notwithstanding'}/'in spite of'/'despite' + sustantivo/V-ing (a pesar de + sustantivo/V-ing)
'even though'/'although' + cláusula (aunque + cláusula con sujeto-verbo completo)
'thereby': de ese modo, como resultado de esta acción
'aside from': aparte de
- El espacio en blanco está antes de la frase nominal 'the large size of the facility' (no una cláusula) -> se necesita una preposición que signifique 'a pesar de'
-> Elegir notwithstanding
part5.tip: Linking words like notwithstanding/despite (+ noun or V-ing) and even though/although (+ clause) require different grammar after them — check whether what follows the blank is a noun phrase or a full clause.
part5.tipVn: Các từ nối như notwithstanding/despite (+ danh từ hoặc V-ing) và even though/although (+ mệnh đề) yêu cầu cấu trúc ngữ pháp khác nhau theo sau — hãy kiểm tra phần sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ hay mệnh đề đầy đủ.
part5.tipTh: คำเชื่อมอย่าง notwithstanding/despite (+ คำนาม หรือ V-ing) กับ even though/although (+ อนุประโยค) ต้องการไวยากรณ์ต่างกันตามหลัง — ตรวจสอบว่าสิ่งที่ตามหลังช่องว่างเป็นวลีคำนามหรืออนุประโยคเต็ม
part5.tipZh: notwithstanding/despite（後接名詞或 V-ing）與 even though/although（後接子句）這類連接詞後面所需的文法不同——請檢查空格之後接的是名詞片語還是完整子句。
part5.tipFr: Des mots de liaison comme notwithstanding/despite (+ nom ou V-ing) et even though/although (+ proposition) nécessitent une grammaire différente après eux — vérifiez si ce qui suit l'espace est un groupe nominal ou une proposition complète.
part5.tipKo: notwithstanding/despite(+ 명사 또는 V-ing)와 even though/although(+ 절) 같은 연결어는 뒤에 서로 다른 문법 구조가 필요합니다 — 빈칸 뒤에 오는 것이 명사구인지 완전한 절인지 확인하세요.
part5.tipJa: notwithstanding/despite（+名詞またはV-ing）と even though/although（+節）のような接続語は後ろに異なる文法を必要とします — 空欄の後に続くのが名詞句か完全な節かを確認しましょう。
part5.tipId: Kata penghubung seperti notwithstanding/despite (+ kata benda atau V-ing) dan even though/although (+ klausa) memerlukan tata bahasa berbeda setelahnya — periksa apakah yang mengikuti bagian kosong adalah frasa kata benda atau klausa lengkap.
part5.tipEl: Συνδετικές λέξεις όπως notwithstanding/despite (+ ουσιαστικό ή V-ing) και even though/although (+ πρόταση) απαιτούν διαφορετική γραμματική μετά από αυτές — ελέγξτε αν αυτό που ακολουθεί το κενό είναι ονοματική φράση ή πλήρης πρόταση.
part5.tipEs: Conectores como notwithstanding/despite (+ sustantivo o V-ing) y even though/although (+ cláusula) requieren gramática distinta después de ellos — revisa si lo que sigue al espacio es una frase nominal o una cláusula completa.

a written (คำคุณศัพท์) {'permit'} (คำนาม) (ใบอนุญาตเป็นลายลักษณ์อักษร)

part5.hintZh:

part5.hintJa:
a written（形容詞）{'permit'}（名詞）（書面による許可証）

-> permitを選択

- Μετά το κτητικό επίθετο 'a written' χρειάζεται ουσιαστικό, και η πρόταση χρειάζεται ουσιαστικό ενικού λόγω του άρθρου 'a'

part5.tip: The same word can be a noun or a verb with a different meaning: "permit" as a verb means "to allow", but as a noun it means "an official document" — check the article "a" before the blank as a clue it's a noun.
part5.tipVn: Cùng một từ có thể vừa là danh từ vừa là động từ với nghĩa khác nhau: "permit" là động từ nghĩa "cho phép", nhưng là danh từ nghĩa "giấy phép" — mạo từ "a" trước chỗ trống là dấu hiệu cho biết đó là danh từ.
part5.tipTh: คำเดียวกันอาจเป็นได้ทั้งคำนามและคำกริยาที่มีความหมายต่างกัน: "permit" เมื่อเป็นกริยาหมายถึง "อนุญาต" แต่เมื่อเป็นคำนามหมายถึง "เอกสารทางการ" — คำนำหน้านาม "a" ก่อนช่องว่างเป็นเบาะแสว่าเป็นคำนาม
part5.tipZh: 同一個詞可以既是名詞又是動詞，意思卻不同："permit" 作動詞時意為「允許」，作名詞時意為「官方文件（許可證）」——空格前的冠詞 "a" 就是提示它是名詞的線索。
part5.tipFr: Le même mot peut être un nom ou un verbe avec un sens différent : "permit" en tant que verbe signifie "permettre", mais en tant que nom il signifie "un document officiel" — vérifiez l'article "a" avant l'espace comme indice qu'il s'agit d'un nom.
part5.tipKo: 같은 단어가 명사와 동사로 쓰이며 뜻이 다를 수 있습니다: "permit"은 동사로는 "허가하다"라는 뜻이지만, 명사로는 "공식 문서(허가증)"라는 뜻입니다 — 빈칸 앞의 관사 "a"는 그것이 명사임을 암시하는 단서입니다.
part5.tipJa: 同じ単語が名詞にも動詞にもなり、意味が異なることがあります："permit" は動詞では「許可する」という意味ですが、名詞では「公式文書（許可証）」という意味です — 空欄の前の冠詞 "a" は、それが名詞であることを示すヒントです。
part5.tipId: Kata yang sama bisa menjadi kata benda atau kata kerja dengan arti berbeda: "permit" sebagai kata kerja berarti "mengizinkan", tetapi sebagai kata benda berarti "dokumen resmi" — periksa artikel "a" sebelum bagian kosong sebagai petunjuk bahwa itu kata benda.
part5.tipEl: Η ίδια λέξη μπορεί να είναι ουσιαστικό ή ρήμα με διαφορετική σημασία: το "permit" ως ρήμα σημαίνει "επιτρέπω", αλλά ως ουσιαστικό σημαίνει "επίσημο έγγραφο" — ελέγξτε το άρθρο "a" πριν το κενό ως ένδειξη ότι είναι ουσιαστικό.
part5.tipEs: La misma palabra puede ser sustantivo o verbo con significado distinto: "permit" como verbo significa "permitir", pero como sustantivo significa "un documento oficial" — revisa el artículo "a" antes del espacio como pista de que es un sustantivo.

part5.tip: Words that look alike (simplified, similar, controversial, contradictory) can trip you up — "simplified" means made easier to understand, while "contradictory" means conflicting with something else.
part5.tipVn: Các từ có hình thức giống nhau (simplified, similar, controversial, contradictory) dễ gây nhầm lẫn — "simplified" nghĩa là được đơn giản hóa, còn "contradictory" nghĩa là mâu thuẫn với điều khác.
part5.tipTh: คำที่หน้าตาคล้ายกัน (simplified, similar, controversial, contradictory) อาจทำให้สับสนได้ — "simplified" หมายถึงทำให้เข้าใจง่ายขึ้น ส่วน "contradictory" หมายถึงขัดแย้งกับสิ่งอื่น
part5.tipZh: 外形相似的詞（simplified、similar、controversial、contradictory）容易讓人出錯——"simplified" 意思是變得更容易理解，而 "contradictory" 意思是與其他事物相矛盾。
part5.tipFr: Des mots qui se ressemblent (simplified, similar, controversial, contradictory) peuvent vous piéger — "simplified" signifie rendu plus facile à comprendre, tandis que "contradictory" signifie en contradiction avec autre chose.
part5.tipKo: 비슷하게 생긴 단어들(simplified, similar, controversial, contradictory)은 혼동을 일으킬 수 있습니다 — "simplified"는 이해하기 쉽게 만들었다는 뜻이고, "contradictory"는 다른 것과 상충한다는 뜻입니다.
part5.tipJa: 見た目が似た語（simplified、similar、controversial、contradictory）は間違いのもとです — "simplified" は理解しやすくされたという意味で、"contradictory" は他と矛盾しているという意味です。
part5.tipId: Kata-kata yang terlihat mirip (simplified, similar, controversial, contradictory) bisa membuat bingung — "simplified" berarti dibuat lebih mudah dipahami, sedangkan "contradictory" berarti bertentangan dengan hal lain.
part5.tipEl: Λέξεις που μοιάζουν (simplified, similar, controversial, contradictory) μπορεί να σας μπερδέψουν — το "simplified" σημαίνει ότι έγινε πιο εύκολο στην κατανόηση, ενώ το "contradictory" σημαίνει ότι έρχεται σε αντίθεση με κάτι άλλο.
part5.tipEs: Las palabras que se parecen (simplified, similar, controversial, contradictory) pueden confundirte — "simplified" significa hecho más fácil de entender, mientras que "contradictory" significa que contradice algo más.

part5.hintFr:

part5.tip: Comparative structures follow the pattern ADJ/ADV + -er + than — whenever you see "than" later in the sentence, that's the signal the blank needs a comparative form.
part5.tipVn: Cấu trúc so sánh hơn theo mẫu ADJ/ADV + -er + than — bất cứ khi nào thấy "than" xuất hiện sau trong câu, đó là dấu hiệu chỗ trống cần dạng so sánh hơn.
part5.tipTh: โครงสร้างเปรียบเทียบตามแบบ ADJ/ADV + -er + than — เมื่อใดที่เห็น "than" ปรากฏภายหลังในประโยค นั่นคือสัญญาณว่าช่องว่างต้องการรูปเปรียบเทียบ
part5.tipZh: 比較結構遵循 ADJ/ADV + -er + than 的模式——只要句子後面出現 "than"，就是空格需要比較級形式的信號。
part5.tipFr: Les structures comparatives suivent le schéma ADJ/ADV + -er + than — dès que vous voyez "than" plus loin dans la phrase, c'est le signal que l'espace a besoin d'une forme comparative.
part5.tipKo: 비교 구조는 ADJ/ADV + -er + than 패턴을 따릅니다 — 문장 뒤쪽에서 "than"이 보이면 빈칸에 비교급이 필요하다는 신호입니다.
part5.tipJa: 比較構文は ADJ/ADV + -er + than というパターンに従います — 文の後ろに "than" が見えたら、それは空欄が比較級を必要としている合図です。
part5.tipId: Struktur komparatif mengikuti pola ADJ/ADV + -er + than — setiap kali Anda melihat "than" muncul kemudian dalam kalimat, itu adalah sinyal bahwa bagian kosong membutuhkan bentuk komparatif.
part5.tipEl: Οι συγκριτικές δομές ακολουθούν το μοτίβο ADJ/ADV + -er + than — όποτε δείτε το "than" αργότερα στην πρόταση, αυτό είναι το σήμα ότι το κενό χρειάζεται συγκριτική μορφή.
part5.tipEs: Las estructuras comparativas siguen el patrón ADJ/ADV + -er + than — cuando veas "than" más adelante en la oración, esa es la señal de que el espacio necesita una forma comparativa.

part5.tipId: Subjek tunggal ("The next work of art") yang dipasangkan dengan kata kerja pasif memerlukan "is/are + V3", dan pasif present simple menggambarkan fakta umum, bukan tindakan yang sedang berlangsung atau selesai.

part5.tip: Prepositions and conjunctions that look similar (besides, rather, among, along) serve very different grammatical roles — "besides" means "in addition to", so check whether the sentence is adding information or comparing.

part5.tipTh: "Thereafter" (นับจากจุดนั้นเป็นต้นไป) เป็นคำเชื่อมเวลาที่เป็นทางการซึ่งพบบ่อยในบทอ่าน TOEIC — ทำรายการคำเชื่อมทางการเหล่านี้ (hereby, thereof, thereafter) เพราะพบได้น้อยในการพูดทั่วไป
part5.tipZh: "Thereafter"（自那時起）是 TOEIC 閱讀文章中常見的正式時間連接詞——建立這些正式連接詞（hereby、thereof、thereafter）的小清單，因為它們在日常口語中很少出現。
part5.tipFr: "Thereafter" (à partir de ce moment) est un connecteur temporel formel courant dans les textes de lecture TOEIC — dressez une petite liste de ces connecteurs formels (hereby, thereof, thereafter) car ils apparaissent rarement dans le langage courant.
part5.tipKo: "Thereafter"(그 이후로)는 TOEIC 독해 지문에 흔히 나오는 격식체 시간 연결어입니다 — 일상 회화에서는 거의 쓰이지 않으니 이러한 격식체 연결어(hereby, thereof, thereafter) 목록을 작게 만들어 두세요.
part5.tipJa: "Thereafter"（それ以降）はTOEICの読解文でよく見られる正式な時間の接続語です — 日常会話ではめったに出てこないので、こうした正式な接続語（hereby、thereof、thereafter）の小さなリストを作りましょう。

ATTENTION ALL TENANTS

'Wimberley Group' will ---(131.)--- its rent collection system to electronic one. This change will apply to all apartments effective February 1. ---(132.)---. Cash and personal checks will no longer be accepted.

Every tenant needs to create a user profile an www.wimberlygroup.com. After logging in, tenants will be able to ---(133.)--- a payment. You can do this by selecting the unpaid bill and then clicking on the button at the bottom of the screen. ---(134.)--- you hit 'Pay', the amount you designate will be deducted from your registered credit card or bank account. If you wish to arrange automatic payments, please click the button labeled 'Pay this amount every month.'

Thank you for you cooperation. If you have any questions, e-mail us at help@wimberlygroup.com.

THÔNG BÁO DÀNH CHO TẤT CẢ NGƯỜI THUÊ NHÀ

'Wimberley Group' sẽ chuyển đổi hệ thống thu tiền thuê nhà sang hình thức điện tử. Thay đổi này sẽ áp dụng cho tất cả các căn hộ kể từ ngày 1 tháng 2. Kể từ ngày đó, người thuê nhà phải thanh toán tiền thuê trực tuyến. Tiền mặt và séc cá nhân sẽ không còn được chấp nhận nữa.

Mỗi người thuê nhà cần tạo một hồ sơ người dùng tại www.wimberlygroup.com. Sau khi đăng nhập, người thuê sẽ có thể thực hiện một khoản thanh toán. Bạn có thể làm điều này bằng cách chọn hóa đơn chưa thanh toán rồi nhấp vào nút ở cuối màn hình. Ngay khi bạn nhấn 'Pay', số tiền bạn chỉ định sẽ được trừ từ thẻ tín dụng hoặc tài khoản ngân hàng đã đăng ký của bạn. Nếu bạn muốn thiết lập thanh toán tự động, vui lòng nhấp vào nút có nhãn 'Pay this amount every month'.

Cảm ơn sự hợp tác của quý vị. Nếu có bất kỳ câu hỏi nào, vui lòng gửi email cho chúng tôi tại help@wimberlygroup.com.

'Wimberley Group' sẽ chuyển đổi hệ thống thu tiền thuê nhà sang hình thức điện tử.
Convert A to B: chuyển đổi A sang B.
Loại induce (xúi giục), fluctuate (dao động) vì sai nghĩa. Loại recover (phục hồi) vì sai nghĩa và không đi với 'to' theo nghĩa này.

132. From that day on, tenants must pay their rental fees online.
Kể từ ngày đó, người thuê nhà phải thanh toán tiền thuê trực tuyến.
Câu điền vào phải nối tiếp ý 'effective February 1' (có hiệu lực từ ngày 1/2) và dẫn đến câu sau đó 'Cash and personal checks will no longer be accepted' (tiền mặt và séc sẽ không còn được chấp nhận) — chỉ đáp án này nói về việc thanh toán trực tuyến.
Loại các đáp án còn lại vì không liên quan hoặc mâu thuẫn với nội dung xung quanh.

133. Tenants will be able to make a payment.
Người thuê sẽ có thể thực hiện một khoản thanh toán.
Make a payment: thực hiện thanh toán (collocation cố định).
Loại postpone (hoãn lại), cancel (hủy), oppose (phản đối) vì sai nghĩa.

134. As soon as you hit 'Pay', the amount you designate will be deducted from your registered credit card or bank account.
Ngay khi bạn nhấn 'Pay', số tiền bạn chỉ định sẽ được trừ từ thẻ tín dụng hoặc tài khoản ngân hàng đã đăng ký của bạn.
As soon as + S + V (hiện tại), S + will + V: diễn tả một hành động xảy ra ngay sau một hành động khác.
Loại Even though (mặc dù), During (trong suốt - cần cụm danh từ), Since (kể từ khi/vì) vì sai nghĩa hoặc sai cấu trúc.

part6.description:
To: Angela Thornberry <athornberry@fastmail.com>
From: Vincent Nakamura <vnakamura@traxcomputers.com>
Subject: Your laptop
Date: June 18

Dear Ms. Thornberry

I am writing about the Trax 2700 laptop you dropped off at our store on June 15 because of problems with its screen. After sending it to our ---(135.)--- for examination, we discovered that it contained a faulty component. At present, your laptop is being ---(136.)---. As requested, we are also thoroughly testing the device to see if there are any other issues.

As this problem appears to have been entirely our fault, we will provide you with a $50 voucher to use at our retail store. ---(137.)---, e-coupons for our Web site are also available. Just let us know which you'd prefer.

---(138.)---. If you have not received it by then, please call customer service.

Best wishes,

Vincent Nakamura
Customer Satisfaction Department
part6.hint:
135 - technicians
Send it to our + N: a noun naming the people/department is needed as the object of 'our'

136 - repaired
Context: a faulty component was found and the device is being fixed, then thoroughly tested before being sent back

137 - Alternatively
Alternatively introduces another option/choice (a $50 voucher OR e-coupons)

138. We will send the computer back to you within three days.
The following sentence 'If you have not received it by then...' requires a prior sentence stating when the laptop will be sent back
part6.hintVn:
Kính gửi: Angela Thornberry <athornberry@fastmail.com>
Người gửi: Vincent Nakamura <vnakamura@traxcomputers.com>
Chủ đề: Laptop của quý khách
Ngày: 18 tháng 6

Kính gửi bà Thornberry,

Tôi viết thư này liên quan đến chiếc laptop Trax 2700 mà bà đã mang đến cửa hàng chúng tôi vào ngày 15 tháng 6 vì gặp sự cố về màn hình. Sau khi gửi máy đến bộ phận kỹ thuật viên của chúng tôi để kiểm tra, chúng tôi phát hiện máy có một linh kiện bị lỗi. Hiện tại, laptop của bà đang được sửa chữa. Theo yêu cầu của bà, chúng tôi cũng đang kiểm tra kỹ lưỡng thiết bị để xem có vấn đề nào khác hay không.

Vì sự cố này dường như hoàn toàn là lỗi của chúng tôi, chúng tôi sẽ tặng bà một phiếu quà tặng trị giá 50 đô la để sử dụng tại cửa hàng bán lẻ của chúng tôi. Ngoài ra, phiếu giảm giá điện tử cho trang web của chúng tôi cũng có sẵn. Xin cho chúng tôi biết bà muốn chọn loại nào.

Chúng tôi sẽ gửi lại máy tính cho bà trong vòng ba ngày. Nếu bà chưa nhận được máy vào lúc đó, vui lòng gọi cho bộ phận chăm sóc khách hàng.

Trân trọng,

Vincent Nakamura
Bộ phận Chăm sóc Khách hàng
135. After sending it to our technicians for examination, we discovered that it contained a faulty component.
Sau khi gửi máy đến bộ phận kỹ thuật viên của chúng tôi để kiểm tra, chúng tôi phát hiện máy có một linh kiện bị lỗi.
Sau tính từ sở hữu 'our' cần một danh từ chỉ người/bộ phận thực hiện việc kiểm tra máy.
Loại technicality (tính kỹ thuật - danh từ trừu tượng), technical (tính từ), technology (công nghệ) vì sai nghĩa hoặc sai từ loại.

136. At present, your laptop is being repaired.
Hiện tại, laptop của bà đang được sửa chữa.
Ngữ cảnh cho biết máy có linh kiện lỗi và đang được kiểm tra thêm trước khi gửi lại — máy đang được 'sửa chữa', không phải thay thế, vận chuyển hay thu hồi.
Loại replaced (thay thế), shipped (vận chuyển), recalled (thu hồi) vì sai nghĩa.

137. Alternatively, e-coupons for our Web site are also available.
Ngoài ra, phiếu giảm giá điện tử cho trang web của chúng tôi cũng có sẵn.
Alternatively: một cách khác, giới thiệu một lựa chọn khác (phiếu quà tặng HOẶC phiếu giảm giá điện tử).
Loại Regrettably (đáng tiếc), Subsequently (sau đó), Approximately (khoảng chừng) vì sai nghĩa.

138. We will send the computer back to you within three days.
Chúng tôi sẽ gửi lại máy tính cho bà trong vòng ba ngày.
Câu sau đó 'If you have not received it by then...' (Nếu bà chưa nhận được máy vào lúc đó) cần một câu trước đó nêu rõ thời điểm máy sẽ được gửi trả.
Loại các đáp án còn lại vì không liên quan đến việc gửi trả máy đúng hạn.

part6.description:
To: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.signh@indiaclothing.in>
From: Faria Deveraj <f.deveraj@mumbai.gov.in>
Subject: Scheduled Inspection
Date: October 12

Dear Mr. Singh,

On October 17, your clothing factory will face its yearly government inspection. This annual ---(143.)--- will verify that all labor laws are being followed. Your factory passed the ---(144.)--- evaluation with no major problems, so our inspectors hope to see a similar level of compliance this time around.

You are ---(145.)--- obliged to provide access to any part of the factory that the inspectors may wish to see. Failure to comply in this regard may result in fines and further investigation. Also, the inspectors need to confirm that workers are being properly compensated. ---(146.)---.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Faria Deveraj
Inspection Team Leader
City Government of Mumbai
part6.hint:
143 - assessment
'This annual ___' refers back to 'its yearly government inspection' in the previous sentence — a synonym for inspection is needed

144 - previous
The October 17 inspection is upcoming, so 'no major problems' must refer to an earlier (previous) evaluation

145 - legally
An adverb is needed to modify the passive verb 'obliged' (are ___ obliged)

146. The human resources department will need to prepare the relevant documents.
Follows logically from 'the inspectors need to confirm that workers are being properly compensated,' which requires payroll/compensation documents
part6.hintVn:
Kính gửi: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.signh@indiaclothing.in>
Người gửi: Faria Deveraj <f.deveraj@mumbai.gov.in>
Chủ đề: Đợt thanh tra theo lịch trình
Ngày: 12 tháng 10

Kính gửi ông Singh,

Vào ngày 17 tháng 10, nhà máy may mặc của ông sẽ trải qua đợt thanh tra hàng năm của chính phủ. Đợt đánh giá thường niên này sẽ xác minh rằng tất cả các luật lao động đều đang được tuân thủ. Nhà máy của ông đã vượt qua đợt đánh giá trước đó mà không có vấn đề lớn nào, vì vậy các thanh tra viên của chúng tôi hy vọng sẽ thấy một mức độ tuân thủ tương tự trong lần này.

Ông có nghĩa vụ hợp pháp phải cho phép tiếp cận bất kỳ khu vực nào trong nhà máy mà các thanh tra viên muốn xem xét. Việc không tuân thủ điều này có thể dẫn đến tiền phạt và điều tra thêm. Ngoài ra, các thanh tra viên cần xác nhận rằng công nhân đang được trả lương đúng theo quy định. Bộ phận nhân sự sẽ cần chuẩn bị các tài liệu liên quan.

Cảm ơn ông đã quan tâm đến vấn đề này.

Faria Deveraj
Trưởng nhóm Thanh tra
Chính quyền Thành phố Mumbai
143. This annual assessment will verify that all labor laws are being followed.
Đợt đánh giá thường niên này sẽ xác minh rằng tất cả các luật lao động đều đang được tuân thủ.
'This annual ___' nhắc lại ý 'its yearly government inspection' ở câu trước — cần một từ đồng nghĩa với 'inspection' (thanh tra, đánh giá).
Loại meeting (cuộc họp), investment (đầu tư), commemoration (lễ kỷ niệm) vì sai nghĩa.

144. Your factory passed the previous evaluation with no major problems.
Nhà máy của ông đã vượt qua đợt đánh giá trước đó mà không có vấn đề lớn nào.
Đợt thanh tra ngày 17/10 là sắp diễn ra (forthcoming), nên 'không có vấn đề lớn' phải nói về đợt đánh giá đã qua (trước đó).
Loại decided (đã quyết định), forthcoming (sắp tới), ultimate (cuối cùng) vì sai nghĩa/mâu thuẫn ngữ cảnh.

145. You are legally obliged to provide access to any part of the factory.
Ông có nghĩa vụ hợp pháp phải cho phép tiếp cận bất kỳ khu vực nào trong nhà máy.
Cần trạng từ (adverb) để bổ nghĩa cho động từ bị động 'obliged' (are ___ obliged).
Loại legality (danh từ), legal (tính từ), legitimate (tính từ) vì sai từ loại.

146. The human resources department will need to prepare the relevant documents.
Bộ phận nhân sự sẽ cần chuẩn bị các tài liệu liên quan.
Câu này nối tiếp hợp lý với ý 'the inspectors need to confirm that workers are being properly compensated' (các thanh tra viên cần xác nhận công nhân được trả lương đúng quy định), nên cần tài liệu về lương/nhân sự.
Loại các đáp án còn lại vì không liên quan đến việc trả lương cho công nhân.

Cardigan Bay General Hospital Fundraising Dinner

You are cordially invited to attend a dinner fundraiser in aid of Cardigan bay General Hospital on April 25 at 7:30 P.M. in the Iris Room at the Beaufort Hotel.

The hospital was first built in 1960, and while much of it has been completely renovated, the east wing has barely changed since the opening day. In order to make improvements to it, the hospital needs about $300,000, which this dinner will raise funds for.

Tickets can be purchased for $100 at the hospital's main reception desk. Those purchasing four tickets or more at one time will receive a copy of Dr. Dianne Larsen's book on nutrition, Food Fit, valued at $25, as a gift.

We sincerely hope you will attend so that the hospital can make some necessary upgrades that will improve the level of care we provide.

part7.description:
TO: Steven Joyce <sjoyce@fastmail.com>
FROM: Fast Track Records <information@fasttrackrecords.com>
DATE: May 20
SUBJECT: Information
Dear Mr. Joyce,

Every year on the third Satuday of May, we celebrate Record Store Day as a way to honor the independent spirit of record stores. That means Fast Track Records will once again be partnering with all the other major stores in the city for a day of music celebration. As you are member of our Music Fans Club, we are forwarding you some of the planned highlights of the day:

11A.M. -12P.M.John Kher, Sarah Feinstein, Ernest Yates, and other local music critics will be reading selections from their work at Gold Sounds Records.
12P.M. -5P.M.Marshalltown Records will be offering a special discount on all jazz and blues records. Stop by their store and receive up to 50% off on your favorite albums.
1P.M. -5P.M.Duke Records will stage a raffle for a variety of merchandise, including vinyl cases, T-shirts, and other memorabilia.
2:30P.M. -3:30P.M.Local rock band The Chimney Sweeps will be performing an in-store concert at Desert Island Records.
4P.M. -5P.M.Gold Sounds Records will be holding a music-themed trivia competition. Winners will receive special prizes including autographed CDs and posters.
5 P.M.A small after-party will be held at Marshalltown Records.

If you have questions about the events and activities, call Fast Track Records at 555-3009 or send a reply to this e-mail. A detailed schedule with further festivities can be found at www.fasttrackrecords.com/recordstoreday.

part7.description:
Eagle Canyon City Park

Over the past month, there has been a sharp increase in reported sightings of raccoons in the open spaces of the park. The park rangers suspect the creatures are attracted by food scraps that are left - whether on purpose of accidentally - by visitors to the park. -- [1] --. The city's public health department does not want to encourage the raccoons to leave the wooded areas of the park as they can be carriers of disease and pose a risk to visitors and their pets. -- [2] --. With that in mind:

  • Please do not leave any garbage in the park - either take it with you when you leave, or please it in the closed garbage bins that are provided throughout the park.
  • If you see reccoons, do not approach them or give them food as they are wild animals with sharp claws and can be dangerous when feel frightened.

-- [3] --. Along with this, we will be holding volunteer park cleanups on the last Saturday of each month. Our next one is scheduled for June 27. Anyone interested in taking park should report to the park visitor center to register. -- [4] --. All participants will be provided with protective gloves and vests, water, and a light lunch.

A. They are petential threats to other animals.
{B. They should only be approached under staff supervision.}
C. They are drawn toward food left by humans.
D. They pose a hazard when feeling scared.

The notice says raccoons "can be carriers of disease and pose a risk to visitors and their pets" (a threat to other animals), are attracted by "food scraps ... left ... by visitors", and "can be dangerous when [they] feel frightened" — but visitors are told not to approach them at all ("do not approach them or give them food"), never that approaching is fine under staff supervision.

Position [4] comes right after "Anyone interested in taking part should report to the park visitor center to register" and right before "All participants will be provided with..." — the inserted sentence about the registration deadline fits logically between those two, continuing the registration topic before moving on to what participants receive.

"공원의 개방된 공간에서 너구리 목격 신고가 급증했습니다 ... 이를 감안하여:"
159. 너구리에 대해 언급되지 않은 것은 무엇인가요?
A. 다른 동물에게 잠재적 위협이 된다
{B. 직원 감독하에서만 접근해야 한다}
C. 사람이 남긴 음식에 끌린다
D. 겁을 먹으면 위험할 수 있다

공지는 너구리가 "can be carriers of disease and pose a risk to visitors and their pets"(다른 동물에게 위협)라고 하며, "food scraps ... left ... by visitors"에 끌리고, "can be dangerous when [they] feel frightened"라고 하지만 — 방문객들은 전혀 접근하지 말라는 안내를 받습니다("do not approach them or give them food"), 직원 감독하에 접근하는 것이 괜찮다는 내용은 없습니다
160. 자원봉사자는 무엇을 받게 되나요?
A. 공원 지도
B. 동물에게 나눠줄 음식
C. 성취 인증서
{D. 보호 장비}

"All participants will be provided with protective gloves and vests, water, and a light lunch."
161. 다음 문장은 [1], [2], [3], [4] 중 어느 위치에 가장 적합한가요?

'We will accept registration forms up to two days prior to the event.'
A. [1]
B. [2]
C. [3]
{D. [4]}

위치 [4]는 "Anyone interested in taking part should report to the park visitor center to register" 바로 다음이고 "All participants will be provided with..." 바로 앞에 위치합니다 — 등록 마감일에 관한 삽입 문장은 이 두 문장 사이에 논리적으로 들어맞으며, 참가자가 받는 것으로 넘어가기 전에 등록 주제를 이어갑니다

158. なぜこの告知は書かれましたか？
A. 公開会議を発表するため
B. 野生動物公園の開園を発表するため
C. ビジターセンターへの案内を提供するため
{D. 訪問者に問題を警告するため}

"there has been a sharp increase in reported sightings of raccoons in the open spaces of the park ... With that in mind:"、続いて訪問者向けの規則一覧
=>
「公園の開けたエリアでのアライグマの目撃報告が急増しています…それを踏まえて：」
159. アライグマについて述べられていないことは何ですか？
A. 他の動物への潜在的な脅威である
{B. スタッフの監督下でのみ近づくべきである}
C. 人間が残した食べ物に引き寄せられる
D. 怖がると危険になる

告知にはアライグマが「can be carriers of disease and pose a risk to visitors and their pets」（他の動物への脅威）、「food scraps ... left ... by visitors」に引き寄せられる、「can be dangerous when [they] feel frightened」とありますが——訪問者は全く近づかないよう言われており（「do not approach them or give them food」）、スタッフの監督下なら近づいてもよいとは一度も述べられていません
160. ボランティアは何を支給されますか？
A. 公園の地図
B. 動物に配る食べ物
C. 達成証明書
{D. 防護具}

"All participants will be provided with protective gloves and vests, water, and a light lunch."
161. 次の文は[1]、[2]、[3]、[4]のどの位置に最も適していますか？

'We will accept registration forms up to two days prior to the event.'
A. [1]
B. [2]
C. [3]
{D. [4]}

位置[4]は「Anyone interested in taking part should report to the park visitor center to register」の直後、「All participants will be provided with...」の直前にあります——登録締め切りについての挿入文はこの2文の間に論理的に収まり、参加者が受け取るものに移る前に登録の話題を続けます

=>

A. Mereka adalah ancaman potensial bagi hewan lain.

'We will accept registration forms up to two days prior to the event.'
A. [1]
B. [2]
C. [3]

Posisi [4] tepat setelah "Anyone interested in taking part should report to the park visitor center to register" dan tepat sebelum "All participants will be provided with..." — kalimat yang disisipkan tentang tenggat waktu pendaftaran secara logis cocok di antara kedua kalimat itu, melanjutkan topik pendaftaran sebelum beralih ke apa yang diterima peserta

{D. Για να ειδοποιήσει τους επισκέπτες για ένα πρόβλημα}

"there has been a sharp increase in reported sightings of raccoons in the open spaces of the park ... With that in mind:", ακολουθούμενο από μια λίστα κανόνων για τους επισκέπτες
=>
«σημειώθηκε απότομη αύξηση στις αναφερόμενες παρατηρήσεις ρακούν στους ανοιχτούς χώρους του πάρκου ... Έχοντας αυτό υπόψη:»
159. Τι ΔΕΝ αναφέρεται για τα ρακούν;
A. Αποτελούν πιθανές απειλές για άλλα ζώα.
{B. Θα πρέπει να τα πλησιάζει κανείς μόνο υπό την επίβλεψη προσωπικού.}
C. Έλκονται από τροφή που αφήνουν οι άνθρωποι.
D. Αποτελούν κίνδυνο όταν τρομάζουν.

Η ειδοποίηση λέει ότι τα ρακούν «can be carriers of disease and pose a risk to visitors and their pets» (απειλή για άλλα ζώα), έλκονται από «food scraps ... left ... by visitors» και «can be dangerous when [they] feel frightened» — αλλά στους επισκέπτες λέγεται να μην τα πλησιάζουν καθόλου («do not approach them or give them food»), ποτέ ότι το πλησίασμα είναι εντάξει υπό την επίβλεψη προσωπικού
160. Τι θα δοθεί στους εθελοντές;
A. Έναν χάρτη του πάρκου
B. Τροφή για διανομή στα ζώα
C. Πιστοποιητικό επίτευξης
{D. Προστατευτικό εξοπλισμό}

'We will accept registration forms up to two days prior to the event.'
A. [1]
B. [2]
C. [3]
{D. [4]}

Η θέση [4] βρίσκεται ακριβώς μετά το «Anyone interested in taking part should report to the park visitor center to register» και ακριβώς πριν το «All participants will be provided with...» — η εισαγόμενη πρόταση σχετικά με την προθεσμία εγγραφής ταιριάζει λογικά ανάμεσα σε αυτές τις δύο, συνεχίζοντας το θέμα της εγγραφής πριν προχωρήσει σε αυτό που λαμβάνουν οι συμμετέχοντες
part7.hintEs:
158. ¿Por qué se escribió el anuncio?
A. Para declarar una reunión pública
B. Para anunciar la apertura de un parque de vida silvestre
C. Para dar indicaciones a un centro de visitantes
{D. Para alertar a los visitantes de un problema}

"there has been a sharp increase in reported sightings of raccoons in the open spaces of the park ... With that in mind:", seguido de una lista de reglas para los visitantes
=>
«ha habido un fuerte aumento en los avistamientos reportados de mapaches en los espacios abiertos del parque ... Con eso en mente:»
159. ¿Qué NO se indica sobre los mapaches?
A. Son amenazas potenciales para otros animales.
{B. Solo deben acercarse bajo supervisión del personal.}
C. Se sienten atraídos por la comida dejada por humanos.
D. Representan un peligro cuando se sienten asustados.

El aviso dice que los mapaches «can be carriers of disease and pose a risk to visitors and their pets» (una amenaza para otros animales), se sienten atraídos por «food scraps ... left ... by visitors» y «can be dangerous when [they] feel frightened» — pero se les dice a los visitantes que no se acerquen a ellos en absoluto («do not approach them or give them food»), nunca que acercarse esté bien bajo supervisión del personal
160. ¿Qué se les dará a los voluntarios?
A. Un mapa del parque
B. Algo de comida para distribuir a los animales
C. Un certificado de logro
{D. Equipo de protección}

"All participants will be provided with protective gloves and vests, water, and a light lunch."
161. ¿En qué posición de [1], [2], [3] y [4] encaja mejor la siguiente oración?

'We will accept registration forms up to two days prior to the event.'
A. [1]
B. [2]
C. [3]
{D. [4]}

La posición [4] viene justo después de «Anyone interested in taking part should report to the park visitor center to register» y justo antes de «All participants will be provided with...» — la oración insertada sobre la fecha límite de registro encaja lógicamente entre esas dos, continuando el tema del registro antes de pasar a lo que reciben los participantes

Michelle Hanson[11:40]Can I get an update from everyone on promotion project for N-Genz Auto? Our next presentation's been moved up to Tuesday, Auhust 10.
Barry Carr[11:42]The script changes for the TV commercial will be done this afternoon. Other than that, I'm just waiting for production to give me permission to proceed.
Dustin Rodriguez[11:45]Barry, our first choice for the lead actor backed out, so I'm waiting to hear back from the talent agency about a replacement. But still, we can proceed with our shoot on July 18 at Snappy Studios.
Michelle Hanson[11:47]Thank you both. What about the online campaign? My contact at N-Genz Auto is eager to see what's been done.
Willa Hopkins[11:50]Well, I'm in the final stages of developing the Web site. I need about a week more to do the finishing touches, but I'm quite confident we'll be done in time.
Dustin Rodriguez[11:54]Good news I called the agency and was told that my second choice for a performer can do the job.
Barry Carr[11:55]Great, Dustin. I'll send you a copy of the finished script tonight. By the way, I can't make it on the 18th as I need to be at a client meeting, so I'll send Brianna Johns in my place.
Dustin Rodriguez[11:57]No problem, Barry. I'll get in touch with her shortly to make further arrangements.
Michelle Hanson[11:58]It looks like we are on the right track. Dustin, keep me posted on your schedule. Willa, could you send me a link to the site so I can see the progress so far?
Dustin Rodriguez[11:59]Understood. I'll send you the most current schedule I have right now.
Willa Hopkins[11:59]OK, Michelle. I can send you the link now. Just bear in mind there are some issues to work out.

part7.description:
Hanlan's Coffee Company - Ethical Purchasing Policy

At Hanlan's, we know that our customers like to drink only the finest coffee from around the world. We also recognize that they want to be sure that the people who grow that coffee are treated fairly. Many coffee producers provide their employees with poor working conditions and low pay, which are practices that Hanlan's does not support. -- [1] --.

Coffee companies that buy their stock on the open market never know exactly where it comes from. But at Hanlan's, we take a different approach. We have exclusive contracts with farms in Guatemala, Ethiopia, and Vietnam. -- [2]--. Because of this, we know exactly who is producing our coffee and the conditions in which it is being grown. We appreciate all the hard work of our farmers and ensure that they have acceptable working conditions and wages. But our commitment doesn't end there. -- [3]--. Hanlan's pays them an additional 10 percent above curreny market prices as our way of saying 'Thanks.'

Furthermore, to give even more back to these communities, we have started the Hanlan's Development Foundation. Each year through this organization, we put five percent of our total corporate profits into building shcools, water pumps and purification plants, and health care facilities in the towns and villages near where our coffee is grown. The main foal is to make certain that all our workers' children are safe, healthy, and have the chance to go to school and receive a full education. -- [4] --.

Find out more about Hanlan's development projects, our coffee producers, and what you can do to support our cause at www.hanlancoffee.com/foundation.

part7.description:
Ping Software's Head Honored as Tech Woman of the Year

By Carmen Marshall

Rebecca Curtis, CEO of software company Ping, has been named the most successful woman in the tech world by Gadget Lover magazine. Ms. Curtis, who took over the company five years ago and transformed it into a thriving multi-platform enterprise, is expected to deliver an acceptance speech at the Gadget Lover annual conference on December 2.

Ms. Curtis's achievements as CEO have been widely celebrated. When she replaced the previous CEO, Mark Spalding, Ping was mainly known for its word processing software. Due to the influx of new word processing product, Ping's software was not selling as well as it once had. Ms. Curtis quickly reversed that situation by developing a wide range of high-quality software including photo-editing and spreadsheet programs. Now the name 'Ping' is notable for its cutting-edge, dependable technology.

Over the next several years, Ms. Curtis says Ping will create a membership plan for its frequent users. Those who sign up will be able to download new Ping products at reduced rate. Ms. Curtis says the company also plans to redevelop its Web site. With all these plans ahead, Ping is expected to grow even more. Most experts agree that Ms. Curtis has been the primary reason behind the company's success.

part7.description:
City Trends Report - Valencia

Tourism numbers in Valencia have been increasing for three years running as people are beginning to discover this often underrated city on the eastern coast of Spain. At the beginning of the survey period, the city received just under a milion visitors a year, but the latest figures show this has jumped to over 1.4 milion.

There are a number of factors that ca account for this change. The new Sanchez Museum of Iberian Art and its nearby conference facilities to rail services from Valancia to Madrid and Barcelona have reduced travel time significantly. With a major airport expansion due to be completed before the end of the year, things are expected to get even better for Valencia.

In addition, the city government's launch of an international advertising campaign two years ago has also proved beneficial. The city was marketed by television, print, and social media as a tourism destination. Reaction to the campaign continues to be positive.

Finally, as well as its attraction tourists and business visitors, Valencia is increasingly being recognized as an excellent place to live. The consultancy Apollo and Company recently put the city in third place in a report measuring the quality of life in small European cities. They cited its lovely waterfront location, low housing costs, and modern infrastructure as reasons for its high place.

Maxfield Financial Group
May 10
Bethany Aldridge
18 Juniper Road
Westport, CT 06880

Dear Ms. Aldridge,

This letter is in response to your request to sign up for paperless statements. Your statements will now be sent via e-mail on the 25th of each month. All such statements will also be accessible from your online account, and you will be able to print them at your convenience. They will contain all of the same information that is included in your paper statements. In order to protect your account details, please ensure that the debvice you use to download and save your paperless statements is secure.

If you would like a paper statement mailed to your primary address in addition to the paperless one, log on to your account and check the 'Mail my Statement' box under 'Delivery Preferences.' Keep in mind that Maxfield Financial group does charge an annual fee of $24 to clients who choose to receive paper statements. If you would like to stop receiving paperless statements and revert back to mailed paper statements only, return to your account and uncheck 'E-mail my Statement.'

Best regards,

Customer Service
Maxfield Financial Group

To: Bethany Aldridge <bethanyal22@totalmail.net>
From: Customer Service <cs@maxfieldfin.com>
Date: May 25
Subject: Your May Statement
Attachment: May_Statement

Dear Ms. Aldridge,

Please find your Maxfield Financial Group electronic account statement for the month of May attached. As this is the first electronic statemment that has been sent to you, please review it carefully and contact our service center if you have any questions or concerns. We have received your payment, and your copy will arrive via mail within the next five to seven days.

To ensure that you receive monthly statement notifications, make sure to keep a current e-mail and postal address on file with us. If you are planning to change them, simply update them in the 'Personal Information' section of our Web site. If you use a work e-mail address, keep in mind that some companies may block the receipt of employees' personal e-mail.

Sincerely,

Customer Service
Maxfield Financial Group

part7.description:
Announcement for Woodlands Business Owners:

The Woodlands Merchants Association is planning to host Thursday evening concerts on the Center Square lawn from May 28 through July 2, from 6 P.M. until 9 P.M. We have held the concerts over the past few years and have had a good turnout every time. However, these events do entail a significant expense for the association, as we most pay our performers. As a result, we are offering local businesses the opportunity to sponsor a concert. This will help the association to control costs while promoting your stores or shops to the public.

A sponsorship includes a banner with your business name on it that will be attached to the performance stage. You have the option of setting up a promotional booth on the lawn and are allowed to hand out flyers or give away coupons and product samples. Those sponsoring a concert for $500 or more will also have their business's name, logo, and contact information printed with event advertisements in The Woodlands Times newspaper.

The Woodlands Merchant Association aims to bring together the business community and local residents, and the sponsored concerts will be an enjoyable way to achieve that goal. If you would like to participate, contact the event coordinator, Dan Perry, at DanPerry@woodlandsmerchantsassn.com to finalize the sponsorship arrangements.

Woodlands Merchants Association Summer Concert Schedule

Below is the concert schedule. Sponsorship rates were determined by the cost of the performer or band. Each sponsorship package includes a banner and one promotional booth if desired. Co-sponsorship by two companies is also permussible. Any distributed items are not part of the listed cost and must be paid for by the sponsor. Sponsors must be current members of the Woodlands Merchants Association.

DatePerformer or BandStyle of MusicSponsorship Cost
May 28Pearson TrioJazz$450
June 4Amy EvansChildren's Folk$150
June 11Throwback1950's Pop$500
June 18University Chorus*Broadway Tunes$550
June 25Treble TroubleDance and Pop$550
July 2Joe Thomas*Blues$150

*Contract not yet signed. Performers subject to change

part7.description:
Gunton City Council to Consider Blandfolk Superstore Proposal

At a Gunton City Council meeting on May 2, members listened to a presentation from representatives of Blandfolk Superstore about building a branch locally. The retail giant proposed erecting an outlet measuring 9,500 square meters just within city limits on Medford Avenue. However, the chosen land has not yet been authorized for commercial establishments, so Blankfolk has requested that the property be rezoned. Gunton mayor Claire O'Rourke told representatives that the council would discuss the proposition this month and address it at their next meeting in June. A spokesperson for Blankfolk said the corporation hopes the proposal will pass, emphasizing that the development would provide employment for up to 190 local residents.

Gunton Herald
www.guntonherald.com
Home|News|Sports|Business|Entertainment|Lifestyle|Opinion|Contact Us

Readers' Comments

Ronald Pinero posted on May 7:
I am writing in regard to an article printed in your newspaper's May 3 edition about the construction proposal from Blandfolk Superstore. As a long-time business owner in Gunton, I am concerned. I manage Ballas Boutique, a clothing store in the downtown area, and many of my friends and business acquaintances also operate private shops in the city. Large corporate retailers have forced many smaller stores out of business in other locations where they have opened, even when such establishments have been situated on the outskirts of towns. I'm not sure most businesses line mine will be able to compete without significantly dropping prices and, by extension, the quality of our godds. For now, Gunton is very vibrant and diverse city, and I hope the mayor and council members will reject the proposal in order to keep that way.

TORonald Pinero <rpinero@dailymaily.com>
FROMAdeline Morris <amorris@guntoncoc.org>
SUBJECTRequest from Gunton COC
DATEMay 8

Dear Mr.Pinero,

I came across your comments on the Gunton Herald Web site. Your concern is something the board the Gunton Chamber of Commerce has been duscussing, and we agree that something must be done to project stores in the downtown area, like yours. On June 3, the city council will be holding a public meeting that some of us will be attending. It would helpful if you joined us at the event. You could give a short talk describing the concerns you mentioned in your comments. You are welcome to use visual aids, bring supporting documents, and invite others who share our concerns. Please let me know if you would like to participate.

Sincerely yours,

Adeline Morris
Secretary, Gunton Chamber of Commerce

InvoiceDate: October 4

From:Oresund Graphics and Design
49 Rozenstraat, Arnhem, Netherlands
To:Kaiser Investment Services
1 Kornmarkt, Floor 4, Frankfurt, Germany
ServicesCharges
Design, Layout, and Photography of Annual Shareholders Report$745
Design and Layout of Investing with Kaiser Brochure$545
Design and Layout of Terms and Conditions Booklet$300
TOTAL DUE$2,240
Payment is due to in 15 days. Requests for additional changes will incur a $100 surcharge per document. For rush printing, add $250. Please note that we no longer accept checks. All payments must be made by direct bank transfer or electronically through www.friendpay.com. Thank you for your cooperation.
To:Alexander Svensson <alex.svensson@oresund.nl>
From:Christine Kaufmann <ckaufmann@kaiserinvestment.de>
Subject:Changes to publications
Date:October 7

Dear Mr. Svensson,

We received your invoice yesterday along with the proofs. Thank you for your excellent work. I showed the final drafts to our managing director and, overall, he was pleased. However, he has requested that we change the photograph used on the front cover. He thinks it failed to convey the mood we were going for. We have commissioned a photographer to take a new picture, and I will send it to you by Friday. Unfortunately, we cannot move our original due date as the brochures have to be shipped in time for a campaign launch event we have planned for November.

If our request presents a problem, please let me know riught away. You can reach me by phone at 555-2309, extension #42. Otherwise, I will wait to receive your revised invoice. Thank you!

Christine Kaufmann
Publications manager
Kaiser Investment Service

Kaiser Investment Services Company Newsletter
Year-end Message from our CEO

As we come to the end of another year, I want to take this opportunity to thank everyone for their commitment and hard work. Once again, Kaiser Investment Services has outperformed analysts' expectations and generated substantial profits for its clients and shareholders. Not only that, but we also continute top customer satisfaction surveys on financial services companies in Germany. As we reflect on these successes, let us continue to look forward with optimism. In this December issue of the newsletter, learn more about our ongoing expansion into North America and see photos from last month's launch of our marketing campaign in the United States, which was well attended by several potential clients. Other than that, I will see you all at our annual holiday party!

Sincerely,
Matthias Furst

TO: El Paso Center for the Digital Arts <questions@elpasodigital.com>
FROM: Raymond Hardy <rayhardy@goodmail.com>
SUBJECT: Classes
DATE: April 30

To Whom It May Concern:

My name is Raymond Hardy, and I'm the president of an amateur photography club here in El Paso. We heard that your center will be teaching some classes on photography this summer. I also understand you offer a special rate for groups. If so, we are interested in registering. Four of us want to take landscape photography at beginners' level. Another three of our members want to take a more advanced class and would like to know whether you offer any. Could you send me some more information?

Please include details about where these classes are going to take place and how much they'll cost, and I will pass the information on.

Best regards,

Raymond Hardy
President
Homestead Photo Club

NameRaymond HardyAddress2094 Firebird Drive, El Paso, TX 79901
